name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_change_reason: v0.7.10 empty-skip + build-drift-fix release: bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.7.9 -> 0.7.10 in plugin.json + marketplace.json and regenerate the committed plugin tree from current src so #307 (deterministic empty-skip for idle ticks, for #306) plus the loop's #302/#303 reach the installed plugin; the loop merged these as src without a build step, drifting the committed tree so 7 build-drift guards failed, and this release resolves the drift. The #307 fix makes a NON-ACTING once agent-state whose signal rule yields the empty-signal on empty input skip via _empty_skip_result so the loop stops dispatching the triager on an empty pool; rename the version test to test_version_bumped_to_0_7_10_and_consistent (assert 0.7.10 in plugin.json + marketplace.json), add test_shipped_run_tick_carries_307_empty_skip + test_committed_run_tick_carries_307_empty_skip asserting the shipped/committed run_tick carries _empty_skip_result, and advance the housekeep doc baseline (471 -> 486) for the appended per-release section.
